note: Roadworks and access restrictions near Lorenzkirche and the former Kaufhof that are active on 2026-10-05, from the City of Nuremberg roadworks list (nuernberg.de/internet/soer_nbg/alle_baustellen.html), Sör project pages, VAG disruption notices and nordbayern.de. Coordinates come from datasets/osm/altstadt.json (addr:housenumber nodes, or the named street's geometry). Left out: Königstraße 32 (building works 2026-01-19 to 2026-12-31, but no OSM address to place it, and the impact is unknown). Also left out: the closed northern Lorenzer Passage and main hall, closed until about end of 2027 (VAG). That closure is underground only; applying it by radius would wrongly close surface Königstraße. It should go on tunnel=yes footway edges if modelled. Lorenzer Platz redesign: finished, handed over on 2026-07-06, so not included. Checked with nothing relevant for these sites: nordbayern.de summer 2026 roadworks article (only suburbs), VAG Instandhaltungen (only night-time U-Bahn maintenance in 2026), VAG elevator outages (only Fürth Klinikum, 2026-09-18).
